summary.text: Paul Childress is serving his first term in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 83, which includes part of Saline County.

paragraphs.text: Outside the legislature he is Vice-President of Sales for NFP Insurance in Benton, and he previously served as president of the Benton School Board and chairman of the Saline County Planning Commission.
According to the House, he also spent a decade in law enforcement in Saline County, and he lives in Benton with his wife and three children.
